name: Sekai o Seifuku Suru Tame no, 3tsu no Houhou
original_name: 世界を征服するための、３つの方法
source:
It tells the story of a devil king who, in the midst of a battle with a hero, somehow turned himself into a female by taking a secret medicine, which was supposed to give him extraordinary strength!

This sets the stage for a love comedy...
